verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs claim native 4K output for video generation (VIDEO 3.0 / 3.0 Omni), which covers the 1080p-or-above resolution part of the story without external upscaling. Nothing in the pack shows that 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 aspect ratios can be selected natively, so roughly half the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented native aspect-ratio options (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), explicit confirmation that delivery needs no re-encoding, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the resolution claims.
